subtitle: How Ahavamalla Turned a Frontier Town into Kalyani of the World

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of Someshvara I overlooking Kalyani’s ramparts and distant Tungabhadra
panels.action: Someshvara I Ahavamalla stands in royal armour on a fort wall, cloak stirred by wind, gazing over the growing city of Kalyani with the Tungabhadra plains stretching to the horizon.

dialogue.text: In an age of burning frontiers, Someshvara I Ahavamalla raised a dusty town named Kalyani into an imperial heart, while trading blows with the Cholas from Vengi to Kanchi.

i18n.hi: धधकती सरहदों के दौर में सोमेश्वर प्रथम अहवमल्ला ने धूल-भरी कल्याणी को साम्राज्य का दिल बना दिया, और वेङ्गी से काञ्ची तक चोलों से भिड़ता रहा।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Someshvara I seated in council, maps and palm-leaf records spread before him
panels.action: Inside a stone hall, Someshvara I sits on a carved throne, leaning forward over a floor map of the Deccan, palm-leaf grants piled beside him, ministers waiting in a semicircle.

dialogue.text: When Someshvara I took the Later Chalukya throne around 1042 CE, his dynasty was still shaking off its old feudatory chains, caught between restless border chiefs and a rising Chola power.

i18n.hi: सन् १०४२ के आस-पास जब सोमेश्वर प्रथम ने उत्तर चालुक्य सिंहासन लिया, तब वंश अभी पुराने अधीनता के बंधन झाड़ ही रहा था, बेचैन सरहदी सामन्तों और उठते चोल बल के बीच फँसा हुआ।

panels.shot: wide shot of Manyakheta’s older palace fading into the background as Kalyani’s newer fort rises in the foreground
panels.action: A cinematic split-scene shows the aging halls of Manyakheta on one side and, on the other, new walls and towers of Kalyani being built by workers under Someshvara’s watch.

dialogue.text: The old Rashtrakuta capital of Manyakheta carried another age’s memories. Someshvara chose instead Kalyani, a frontier town on the Krishna–Tungabhadra corridor, and began to pour stone, coin and will into it.

i18n.hi: पुरानी राष्ट्रकूट राजधानी मण्यखेङ्गा पिछली सदी की यादें ढोती थी। सोमेश्वर ने चुनी कल्याणी—कृष्णा–तुङ्गभद्रा मार्ग पर एक सरहदी नगर—और उसमें पत्थर, धन और इरादा उँड़ेलना शुरू कर दिया।

panels.shot: medium shot of Someshvara I performing royal rituals in Kalyani amid construction
panels.action: Someshvara I stands before a simple shrine within Kalyani’s half-built citadel, offering sacred fire as masons and elephants haul blocks in the background.

dialogue.text: The Kelawadi inscription of 1053 CE shows Someshvara issuing grants as ‘Trilokamalla’ from this new seat. The title and the city began to travel together, etched into stone across the Deccan.

i18n.hi: १०५३ की केलवाड़ी शिलालेख में सोमेश्वर को ‘त्रिलोकमल्ल’ के रूप में इसी नए आसन से अनुदान देते दिखाया है। उपाधि और नगर साथ-साथ चल पड़े, दक्खिन भर की शिलाओं में उकेरे गए।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye over a map-like landscape showing Kalyani linked by roads toward Annigeri, Vengi and Kanchi
panels.action: A stylized overhead view shows Kalyani at the center with routes stretching toward Annigeri in the north, Vengi to the east, and Kanchi far to the southeast, with troops and caravans moving along them.

dialogue.text: From Kalyani, armies could ride north to Annigeri, east to the contested Vengi delta, and south toward Kanchi. A capital here was not just a city; it was a statement of reach.

i18n.hi: कल्याणी से सेनाएँ उत्तर में अण्णिगेरि, पूरब में विवादित वेङ्गी डेल्टा, और दक्षिण में काञ्ची तक दौड़ सकती थीं। यह राजधानी सिर्फ़ शहर नहीं थी, पहुँच का ऐलान थी।

panels.shot: dynamic battlewide of Chalukya forces clashing with Chola contingents on an open plain near the Krishna-Tungabhadra frontier
panels.action: Someshvara I leads Chalukya cavalry into a dust-filled clash against disciplined Chola infantry bearing tiger-crested banners on a dry frontier field.

dialogue.text: But that reach ran straight into Chola ambition. The Krishna–Tungabhadra frontier became a corridor of campaigns, as Someshvara’s hosts met the armies of Rajadhiraja I in grinding, seesaw war.

i18n.hi: पर वही पहुँच सीधे चोल महत्वाकांक्षा से टकराई। कृष्णा–तुङ्गभद्रा सरहद मुहिमों की गलियारा बन गई, जहाँ सोमेश्वर की सेनाएँ राजाधिराज प्रथम की फौजों से कड़ी, झूला-युद्ध में भिड़ीं।

panels.shot: tight shot on Someshvara’s face in war council, lamplight flickering on his features
panels.action: In a tent lit by oil lamps, Someshvara I leans over a rough campaign map, jaw set, listening to generals gesturing toward the eastern coast.

dialogue.text: Vengi, with its fertile lands and eastern harbours, was the prize. Chola and Chalukya records alike speak of marches, sieges and shifting control there, each text claiming more than the hard ground would give.

i18n.hi: उपजाऊ खेतों और पूर्वी बन्दरगाहों वाला वेङ्गी ही इनाम था। चोल और चालुक्य दोनों के अभिलेख वहाँ के कूच, घेराबन्दी और बदलती हकूमत गिनाते हैं, हर लेख ज़मीन से ज़्यादा दावा करता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of a coastal Vengi town showing alternating scenes of Chalukya and Chola banners over time
panels.action: The same Vengi town is shown in successive vignettes: first with Chalukya standards on its walls, then with Chola tiger flags, then again with Chalukya emblems returning.

dialogue.text: In Vengi the balance swung back and forth. Inscriptions mark Chalukya presence, then Chola ascendancy, then Chalukya return. Neither side’s panegyrics capture the full complexity of this long tug of war.

i18n.hi: वेङ्गी में तराज़ू बार-बार पलटा। कभी शिलालेख चालुक्य मौजूदगी दिखाते हैं, फिर चोल बढ़त, फिर चालुक्य वापसी। दोनों की प्रशस्तियाँ इस लम्बी रस्साकशी की पूरी गाँठ नहीं खोल पातीं।

panels.shot: somber low-angle of Chola troops entering a burning quarter of Kalyani, with Someshvara absent, implied off elsewhere
panels.action: Chola soldiers bearing tiger-crested shields stride through a smoke-filled street before Kalyani’s fort, buildings charred, residents fleeing; Someshvara is not present in the frame.

dialogue.text: Chola records, like the Manimangalam inscription, boast of Rajadhiraja’s sack of Kalyani and victory rites. They celebrate a moment when the new Chalukya capital was overrun and humbled.

i18n.hi: चोल अभिलेख, जैसे मणिमङ्गलम शिलालेख, राजाधिराज द्वारा कल्याणी की लूट और विजय-समारोह का गर्व करते हैं। वे उस पल का जश्न मनाते हैं जब नई चालुक्य राजधानी रौंदी और झुकाई गई।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Someshvara inspecting damaged walls of Kalyani after the sack
panels.action: Someshvara I stands on a battered rampart, touching scorched stone, watching workers and townsfolk clearing debris and beginning repairs below.

dialogue.text: The stones themselves, and later Chalukya inscriptions, show another side: Kalyani rebuilt, royal grants issued again, Someshvara back on campaign. The sack did not end Chalukya power on the Deccan stage.

i18n.hi: पर पत्थर खुद, और बाद के चालुक्य शिलालेख, दूसरी तस्वीर दिखाते हैं: कल्याणी फिर से उठी, राजानुदान फिर जारी हुए, सोमेश्वर फिर अभियान पर निकला। यह लूट दक्खिन पर चालुक्य राज खत्म नहीं कर सकी।

panels.shot: medium battlewide of Chalukya forces advancing toward Kanchi region, with distant temple towers on the horizon
panels.action: Someshvara rides at the head of mailed cavalry moving across dry scrubland toward distant temple towers, symbolising the Kanchi region, banners snapping in the wind.

dialogue.text: Recovered, Someshvara again pushed south. Later campaigns carried Chalukya arms toward Kanchi, testing Chola hold beyond Vengi, proof that the Deccan contest was far from settled.

i18n.hi: संभलकर, सोमेश्वर ने फिर दक्षिण धकेला। बाद की मुहिमों ने चालुक्य हथियारों को काञ्ची तक पहुँचाया, वेङ्गी के पार चोल पकड़ पर चोट की, साबित किया कि दक्खिन की टक्कर अभी मुकम्मल नहीं हुई।

panels.shot: intimate interior shot of Someshvara granting land in Annigeri, inscription being carved nearby
panels.action: In a modest hall at Annigeri, Someshvara I sits beside priests and officials, dictating a land grant as a sculptor chisels text into a stone slab in the background.

dialogue.text: The Hire Hadagali Kalleshvara inscription of 1057 CE and other records from places like Annigeri show Someshvara ruling, gifting and asserting from Kalyani’s orbit, his imperial titles now linked to this frontier capital.

i18n.hi: १०५७ के हिरिहडगली कल्लेश्वर अभिलेख और अण्णिगेरि जैसे स्थानों के अन्य लेख दिखाते हैं कि सोमेश्वर कल्याणी के घेरे से ही राज, दान और दावा कर रहा था, उसकी सम्राटी उपाधियाँ अब इस सरहदी राजधानी से बँध गई थीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of Kalyani bustling with traders, scholars and soldiers under Someshvara’s gaze from a balcony
panels.action: Someshvara stands on a palace balcony overlooking Kalyani’s busy streets, where traders, temple musicians, scribes and armed retainers move under rising spires and fortified gates.

dialogue.text: By the 1050s, Kalyani was no longer a mere stronghold. It had become the Chalukya name, a place from which Someshvara’s court reached across Karnataka, Andhra, and into the Tamil country.

i18n.hi: १०५० के दशक तक कल्याणी सिर्फ़ क़िला भर नहीं रही। वह चालुक्य नाम बन गई—एक जगह, जहाँ से सोमेश्वर दरबार कर्नाटक, आन्ध्र और तमिल देश तक हाथ बढ़ा रहा था।

panels.shot: serene riverside wide on the Tungabhadra at dusk, Someshvara alone near the water
panels.action: At dusk on the Tungabhadra’s bank, Someshvara I stands quietly, crown set aside, looking out over the calm river as the sky glows orange.

dialogue.text: On 29 March 1068, tradition says Someshvara took jalasamadhi in the Tungabhadra, entering the river by choice. Few medieval kings have a recorded death so precise in date and place.

i18n.hi: २९ मार्च १०६८ को, परम्परा कहती है कि सोमेश्वर ने तुङ्गभद्रा में जलसमाधि ली, ख़ुद नदी में प्रवेश किया। कुछ ही मध्ययुगीन राजाओं की मृत्यु इतनी साफ़ तारीख़ और जगह के साथ लिखी मिली है।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from Someshvara stepping into the river, framed against Kalyani’s distant silhouette
panels.action: Someshvara I steps into the shallow edge of the Tungabhadra, robes trailing in the water, while far behind him Kalyani’s fort silhouette stands against the horizon.

dialogue.speaker: someshvara_i
dialogue.text: Let Kalyani stand, whatever befalls its king.

i18n.hi: राजा का जो भी हो, कल्याणी को खड़े रहने दो।

panels.shot: timelapse-style wide of Kalyani’s skyline changing through generations, Someshvara’s statue in foreground
panels.action: A stone statue of Someshvara I stands in the foreground as the skyline of Kalyani behind it shifts through eras, walls repaired, new halls rising, suggesting continuity beyond his life.

dialogue.text: Someshvara’s wars did not fix borders forever, but the choice of Kalyani did fix a memory. Later rulers, scholars and inscriptions remembered the dynasty by this city’s name.

i18n.hi: सोमेश्वर की लड़ाइयाँ सीमाएँ हमेशा के लिए नहीं गाँठ सकीं, पर कल्याणी की उसकी पसंद ने याद हमेशा बाँध दी। बाद के राजे, विद्वान और शिलालेख इस वंश को इसी नगर के नाम से याद करते रहे।

panels.shot: reflective close-up on Someshvara’s carved name in an inscription slab from Kalyani
panels.action: A close-up shows Someshvara I’s titles, including Ahavamalla and Trilokamalla, carefully carved on a weathered inscription slab set in Kalyani’s temple wall.

dialogue.text: His story leaves a quiet lesson: in shifting a capital, Someshvara did more than move stone. He named a frontier as the center, and turned geography itself into an imperial declaration.

i18n.hi: उसकी कहानी एक शांत सबक छोड़ जाती है: राजधानी बदलते सोमेश्वर ने सिर्फ़ पत्थर नहीं हटाए। उसने सरहद को ही केंद्र का नाम दिया, और भूगोल को साम्राज्य की घोषणापत्र बना डाला।

subtitle_i18n.en: How Ahavamalla Turned a Frontier Town into Kalyani of the World
subtitle_i18n.hi: अहवमल्ला ने सरहदी क़स्बे को बनाया दुनिया की कल्याणी
